title: ACTIVE FRAMEWORK vs LEGACY QTA: the boundary's own rules
note: tools/framework_boundary.py measures the directive-10 boundary; each rule it applies is removed here and a planted violation in tests/test_framework_boundary.py must notice.

mutations.name: FB1_lazy_imports_are_not_dependencies
mutations.rationale: an import inside a function is not a dependency, so the run_all edge would pass

mutations.name: FB2_importing_a_submodule_runs_no_package
mutations.rationale: a package initialiser that reaches legacy taints nothing

mutations.name: FB3_the_closure_is_not_transitive
mutations.rationale: a legacy module two imports away is never reached

mutations.name: FB4_nothing_is_legacy
mutations.rationale: the legacy side is empty and every import passes

mutations.name: FB5_legacy_files_may_be_named
mutations.rationale: an active module names the BOM and nothing notices

mutations.name: FB6_every_legacy_file_is_matched_by_name
mutations.find:
self.legacy_basenames = {p for p in self.legacy_files
                                 if "/" not in p}
mutations.rationale: a generic SHA256SUMS is mistaken for the legacy release's

mutations.name: FB7_ontology_tokens_are_not_read
mutations.find: if any(t in n for t in self.tokens))
mutations.rationale: a renamed legacy FSM module is imported and nothing notices

mutations.name: FB8_an_exception_covers_everything
mutations.find: return any("names" not in e or name in e["names"]
mutations.replace: return True or any("names" not in e or name in e["names"]
mutations.rationale: an exception for one legacy file excuses every file

mutations.name: FB9_stale_exceptions_are_kept
mutations.rationale: an exception that excuses nothing any more is never removed

mutations.name: FB10_unclassified_files_pass
mutations.find: out.append(f"UNCLASSIFIED: {p} has no disposition the boundary "
mutations.replace:
continue
            out.append(f"UNCLASSIFIED: {p} has no disposition the boundary "
mutations.rationale: a production file on neither side is never placed

mutations.name: FB11_tests_are_in_scope
mutations.find: self.in_scope = {p for p in self.text if not p.startswith(out)}
mutations.rationale: tests that import legacy on purpose make the boundary fail for the wrong reason

mutations.name: FB12_the_check_always_passes
mutations.rationale: the CI step exits 0 with violations printed
